# drogue

> Rate limiting and application-layer protection for Python. FastAPI, Django, Flask, Django REST Framework. No `request: Request` in your signatures.

## Install

```bash
pip install drogue[fastapi]   # or [django], [flask], [drf]
```

## Usage (FastAPI)

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from drogue.adapters.fastapi import DrogueLimiter

app = FastAPI()
limiter = DrogueLimiter(app, default_limits=["100/minute"])

@app.get("/api/data")
@limiter.limit("10/minute")
async def get_data():
    return {"data": "value"}   # no request: Request needed
```

Sync `def` endpoints work too. The decorator handles both.

## Key API

- `DrogueLimiter(app, ...)` - attach to app, optional `default_limits`, `storage`, `key_func`, `config`, `error_renderer`
- `@limiter.limit("10/minute", algorithm=..., key_func=..., block=..., shadow=...)` - per-route limit
- `@limiter.limit_ws("10/minute")` - WebSocket rate limiting
- `DrogueConfig(...)` - enable ban, DDoS, circuit breaker, CIDR, trust, challenges (all off by default)
- `error_renderer(request, exc, headers) -> Response` - custom 429 body

## Rate limit strings

`"100/minute"`, `"10/second;50/minute"` (multi-window), `"100/minute@cost=2"` (cost-aware)

Algorithms: `TOKEN_BUCKET` (default, burst-friendly), `SLIDING_WINDOW`, `FIXED_WINDOW`, `GCRA`, `LEAKY_BUCKET`

## Storage

- `MemoryStorage()` (default, in-process)
- `RedisStorage(url="redis://localhost")` (multi-process)
- `MongoDBStorage(...)` (via Motor)

## Headers

`X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, `Retry-After` injected on all responses by default.

## Migration from slowapi

Remove `request: Request` from endpoints. Replace `Limiter(key_func=...)` with `DrogueLimiter(app)`. drogue defaults to Token Bucket; slowapi uses Fixed Window (strict). Use `algorithm=AlgorithmType.FIXED_WINDOW` to match slowapi semantics.

## What drogue does NOT do

SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication, authorization. Use a dedicated security stack.
